parameters.query:
INSERT INTO accounts (account_name, domain)
VALUES (
    NULLIF($1, ''), 
    NULLIF(NULLIF($2, ''), 'null')
)
ON CONFLICT (account_name) 
DO UPDATE SET domain = COALESCE(accounts.domain, EXCLUDED.domain)
RETURNING account_id;

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM signals 
    WHERE account_id = $1 
      AND signal_type = $2 
      AND detected_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
) AS is_duplicate;

INSERT INTO signals (account_id, signal_type, detected_date, evidence_description, evidence_url, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'Pending_Enrichment');
